tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the identity of the signed-in agenthost account you are acting as. Use to confirm authentication before other calls.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the agenthost projects the account can access. Every app lives inside a project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new agenthost project to hold apps. Start here before creating an app.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get details of a single agenthost project by id or slug.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create a new app or site inside a project, then deploy code to it. Use when the user wants to publish a site, API, or service.

project.description: Project id or slug to create the app in.

runtime.description: Runtime for the app, e.g. 'node', 'python', or 'static'.

tools.name: deploy_from_repo
tools.description: Build and deploy an app directly from a connected GitHub repository in one step.

project.description: Project id or slug to deploy into.

branch.description: Branch to deploy. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the apps in a project, or across all projects the account can access.

project.description: Optional project id or slug to filter by.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get details of a single app: its runtime, URL, current deploy, and status.

tools.name: get_app_logs
tools.description: Read recent build and runtime logs for an app. Use to diagnose a failed deploy or a crashing app.

limit.description: Maximum number of log lines to return.

tools.name: list_deploys
tools.description: List the deploy history for an app, newest first. Use before rolling back.

tools.name: deploy_app
tools.description: Deploy previously uploaded source to an app. Pair with begin_upload for upload-based deploys.

app.description: App id or slug to deploy.

tools.name: rollback_app
tools.description: Restore an app to a previous deploy. Use to recover from a bad release.

deploy.description: Deploy id to roll back to. Defaults to the previous deploy.

tools.name: delete_app
tools.description: Permanently delete an app and stop serving it. This cannot be undone.

app.description: App id or slug to delete.

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a managed database that apps can attach to.

project.description: Project id or slug to create the database in.

tools.name: attach_database
tools.description: Attach a database to an app, exposing its connection details to the app as environment variables.

database.description: Database id or name to attach.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List managed databases in a project.

project.description: Optional project id or slug to filter by.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Add a custom domain to an app. Follow with verify_domain to complete DNS setup.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Verify DNS for a custom domain and issue its certificate.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the custom domains attached to an app and their verification status.

tools.name: manage_env
tools.description: Set, update, or remove environment variables for an app.

set.description: Map of environment variable names to values to set.

tools.name: get_env
tools.description: Read the environment variables configured for an app.

tools.name: share_app
tools.description: Invite a person by email to access a private app. Only invited addresses can open it.

tools.name: create_token
tools.description: Mint a long-lived API token for an unattended client that cannot open a browser. Send it as a Bearer header.

tools.name: contact_support
tools.description: Write a message to an agenthost human for billing, account trouble, or an issue you cannot resolve. Returns a reference.
